summary: Per-edge perimeter classification on the post-merge roof-graph. Tags each edge as perimeter / shared / overhang-top / overhang-bottom / interior-shared / wall / level-transition, and persists an outward XZ unit-vector on perimeter / level-transition edges so wall-detect knows which side is outside the polygon. Also synthesizes eave-shared new-adjacencies between plane pairs not already linked by a ridge.

phases.name: Build id maps
phases.description: Dense plane_id→idx, corner_id→idx, ridge_id→idx lookup arrays (sized to max_id+1 each).

phases.name: Per-plane winding + XZ centroid
phases.description: For every non-wall plane that has a polygon path: compute signed double-area in XZ (winding sign) and unweighted XZ centroid of the path's corners. Both are used by Phase D to pick the outward perpendicular for each edge; centroid is the primary signal, winding is the fallback for degenerate cases.

phases.name: Edge geometry
phases.description: Per input edge: 3D unit direction, XZ unit direction, midpoint, lengths. Edges below `min_edge_len_3d` are dropped (no tag emitted).

phases.name: Classify each edge
phases.description: Per edge: (1) wall-only planeIds → tag=wall. (2) Multi-plane all-roof → tag=interior-shared. (3) Both endpoints share a ridge between two roof planes → tag=interior-shared. (4) Else: compute outward XZ from centroid-vs-perpendicular (winding fallback), then scan all other-plane single-plane roof edges. For each candidate F whose midpoint sits on the OUTWARD side of E (within outward_side_eps tolerance): if 3D-collinear within perim_collinear_min_deg AND |E.mid - F.mid|_3D < perim_dist_3d → coverage type SHARED. Else if XZ-collinear AND |E.mid - F.mid|_XZ < perim_dist_xz → type OVERHANG_TOP/BOTTOM (chosen by midpoint y comparison). Coverage records the t-interval of F's projection on E (clamped to [0,1]). Union the coverages; if covered_fraction > 0.2 → dominant tag (SHARED > OVERHANG_TOP > OVERHANG_BOTTOM); else PERIMETER. Eave-shared adjacencies are recorded for every SHARED coverage.

phases.name: Dedup new adjacencies
phases.description: Pack each plane-pair (planeA, planeB) into a u64 key (lo<<32 | hi). Seed the seen-set with existing ridge plane-pairs; emit only candidates whose key is not already in the set.

phases.name: Level-transition detection
phases.description: Bucket perimeter-tagged roof-wall edges by the wall planes they reference. If a wall plane is referenced by edges from 2+ DIFFERENT roof planes, retag those perimeter edges as level-transition (the wall sits BETWEEN two roof heights).

phases.name: PIP overhang fallback
phases.description: Coverage-loop misses edges that sit INSIDE another plane's XZ footprint without a parallel partner (dormers, raised sections). For each remaining PERIMETER edge: walk in 10cm steps, probe 15cm outward at each step, check XZ-containment against every other non-wall plane's polygon. If ≥ COVERAGE_THRESHOLD probes land inside some other plane → retag as overhang-top (edge sits ABOVE) or overhang-bottom (edge sits BELOW), decided by comparing the edge sample's y vs the y of the highest covering plane at the probe point.

parameters.name: perim_dist_3d
parameters.summary: Phase D — 3D midpoint distance gate for SHARED tag.
parameters.rationale: Two edges that should be the same physical boundary on two adjacent planes can sit up to ~30 cm apart in 3D after boundary-merge. Tighter than this misses real shareds; looser starts catching distinct eaves on opposite sides of a gable.

parameters.name: perim_dist_xz
parameters.summary: Phase D — XZ midpoint distance gate for OVERHANG_* tag.
parameters.rationale: Same scale as 3D for the overhang fallback; height difference is the disambiguator between SHARED and OVERHANG_*.

parameters.name: perim_collinear_min_deg
parameters.summary: Phase D — collinearity gate (3D and XZ).
parameters.rationale: Eaves that should pair under SHARED can have up to ~10° wobble post-merge; 15° absorbs that without picking up corner edges (angle change >= 30°).

parameters.name: perim_min_overlap_m
parameters.summary: Phase D — min coverage length for a candidate to count.
parameters.rationale: Below this, candidates are ambiguous corner-grazes rather than real shared/overhang pairs.

parameters.name: wall_tilt_min_deg
parameters.summary: Phase B/D/F — tilt threshold above which a plane is a wall.
parameters.rationale: Matches the wall_tilt_max_deg used by boundary-merge (72° — anything tilting at least this steep is treated as a wall, not a roof).

parameters.name: pip_probe_offset_m
parameters.summary: Phase G — outward probe offset from the edge.
parameters.rationale: Just outside the edge — enough to land on a neighbouring plane's polygon if it overlaps, small enough to not skip across narrow gaps.

parameters.name: pip_step_len_m
parameters.summary: Phase G — sampling step along the edge.
parameters.rationale: 10 cm gives ~10 probes per 1 m edge; trades resolution for cost (linear in edge length).

parameters.name: pip_coverage_threshold
parameters.summary: Phase G — min fraction of probes that must land inside.
parameters.rationale: Catches edges where ≥half the length sits over another plane; below half is treated as a noise hit.

parameters.name: outward_side_eps
parameters.summary: Phase D — slack on the F-on-inward-side rejection test.
parameters.rationale: Allows almost-tangent candidates to pass the side test (avoids dropping legitimate cross-eave shareds due to sub-cm noise on the perpendicular).

parameters.name: min_edge_len_3d
parameters.summary: Phase C — drop edges shorter than this.
parameters.rationale: Degenerate edges (e.g. a corner snap collapsed both endpoints) have unstable directions; skip them rather than emitting a garbage tag.

parameters.name: min_edge_len_xz
parameters.summary: Phase C — below this XZ length, dxz is set to zero.
parameters.rationale: Vertical edges (wall-only) project to a point in XZ; we still classify them (Phase D wall short-circuit handles the case).

reads.name: per-building-records
reads.summary: Per-bldg record metadata; classify only uses count + schema gate.

reads.name: building-local-frames
reads.summary: Per-bldg centroid for re-shifting double-precision corner positions back to world.

reads.name: boundary-merge-roof-graph
reads.summary: Per-bldg TLV roof-graph carrying post-merge planes / ridges / corners / edges / polygon-paths.

writes.name: boundary-classify-roof-graph
writes.summary: Per-bldg TLV roof-graph: all upstream sections passed through unchanged, with PERIMETER_TAGS (0x0C) + NEW_ADJACENCIES (0x0D) overlays appended. PERIMETER_TAGS records carry the per-edge tag, outward XZ unit vector (bit-0x02 flag), and optional coverage detail.

outputs.summary: Per-edge tag + outward_xz + optional coverage detail. Consumed by wall-detect (outward_xz, tag ∈ {perimeter, level-transition}) and by downstream LOD2 / fit-solar-panels (tag filtering).
Eave-shared plane-pair adjacencies deduped against existing ridges. Consumed by boundary-regularize for extra DOF/locking constraints.
1m outward-normal arrows from each wall-candidate edge midpoint. Will be emitted on emitVizArtifacts gate once lab-ui viz lands.

notes: Iso-equivalence on dahouet-bldgonly (2026-05-26): 5/5 dimensions match v2 byte-by-byte — tag counts identical, per-edge tag mismatches 0/150, outwardXZ presence identical, outwardXZ value max-|Δ|=2.93e-8 (F32 round-trip ceiling), new-adjacency counts identical.
Spec extension: PERIMETER_TAGS flag bit 0x02 (has_outward_xz) is forward-compatible — older readers ignore the optional 8-byte payload immediately after the fixed 8-byte header.
